It’s also not the sort of thing where Blizzard can just delete the quest from existence like when too many people complained about how long it took to escort an old woman in Durotar, so poof, they just removed it which didn’t really make anyone happy. Can’t do that here, it’s just too major an aspect of a character. Those Legion weapons are too important for them NOT to fix it at some point.

posts.name: Brycicle
posts.cooked: I definitely agree here, I understand the importance of artifact weapons as they pertain to finishing order hall campaigns and such, and I do think this should be a priority fix, but I think when I found this bug myself and then learned it was a known issue, I was particularly dismayed especially because I had spent a year trying to do the Fighting on Two Fronts achievement but it has been bugged for so long, and felt like I had made a concession with the game like, “Okay I’ll just go enjoy the order halls” and it JUST so happens that when I get really immersed into my first druid character I was met with yet another bug. I thought Blizz had large teams dedicated to bug fixing, but with the way things go lately it seems like these things will never be fixed. If the focus is on Midnight content at launch it will continue to stay on current content. I mean if it has already taken them over a month to fix this issue, I don’t have much hope for other areas of old content.

posts.cooked: Same for me today, stuck. This is really frustrating to see so many reports on the same bug in a critical quest we can’t move forward without for months with no real update. Gotta love downsizing and AI bots with no reading comprehension or help despite us paying for this game.
